pairs.subject: tenant-scoped-agent-runtime
pairs.evidence: src/features/home/sub_welcome/lib/useVaultCredentials.ts:8 The Welcome surface is a single-owner React dashboard that reads one process-wide vault store and local UI state. A search of src/features/home/sub_welcome, src/features/home/components and src/features/home/lib for 'tenant', 'AsyncLocalStorage', 'task_local' and 'process.env' found nothing, so this context never has one long-lived agent process serving several isolated configurations, which is the subject's precondition.

techniques.evidence: src/features/home/sub_welcome/lib/useVaultCredentials.ts:26 Reads one global Zustand store for one desktop owner. There is no second configuration to scope per task.
src/features/home/sub_welcome/useResumeContext.ts:24 The hook only derives values from existing client store state. It has no shared store object serving several tenants and binds no store handle.
